qa_pair.question: The brand logo (the orange circle) sits inside a comp that is nested inside one of the scenes of the main film. How many seconds into the main film does the logo first become visible? Answer with a number of seconds.
Of the scenes placed in the main film, take the one that plays first. Exactly one layer in it is blurred. What is its blurriness value?
The first scene has a row of repeated rectangles that come on screen one after another. Which of them appears last? Answer with its layer name.
In the second scene, a coloured solid is cut out by another layer's shape. What text does that cutting layer contain?
One rectangle in the first scene moves by itself without any keyframes. By at most how many degrees does it turn away from its rest angle? Answer with a number.
At what time, in seconds, does the main film's camera stop moving?
The main film is divided into sections by timeline markers. How long, in seconds, is the section labelled as the problem?
What font size is the main film's subtitle line set in? Answer with a number.
In the second scene, several single words come on screen at different times. Which word appears last? Answer with the word exactly as it is written.
In the main film, which section marker is active at the moment the third scene begins? Answer with the marker's comment.
